setting: Lab U09-02, change C. Riverside Fabrication is a composite. Renames high to alarm_high on every sensor, keeps schema_version 1.
stale_reason: The Pi samples once a second. Five seconds is five missed samples in a row, long enough that one slow network moment does not cry wolf, short enough that an operator never trusts a number for more than a few seconds after the Pi stops updating it.

sensors.label: Cure oven temperature
sensors.reason: The composite shop's coating cures between 190 and 230 C. Below 190 the coating stays soft and parts get reworked. Above 230 the finish discolors. Normal running sits near 212, so either limit is about 20 degrees away and a real problem crosses it well before parts are ruined.

sensors.label: Press vibration
sensors.reason: Line 3's press runs near 3.1 mm/s when healthy. The composite shop's maintenance lead set the limit at about twice the healthy baseline: a loose mount or a failing bearing shows up as a sustained rise, and 6.0 is far enough above normal wander that it does not alarm on a heavy part. No low limit: a quiet press is not a hazard, and a stopped press is covered by the operator's own view of the line.

sensors.label: Coolant level
sensors.reason: At the composite shop's usage rate, 25 percent leaves roughly one shift of coolant, which is time to refill before the pump runs dry. No high limit: the tank has an overflow, and an overfilled tank is a housekeeping problem, not a machine problem.
